summary: Iteration 12 (Analyse Flotte redesign) fully validated on backend + frontend. Backend: (1) GET /api/groups returns success=true + 13 real Navixy groups incl. LOGITRAK (id 126737); (2) every vehicle in /api/fleet/efficiency now carries an integer group_id, and every group_id used by vehicles exists in /api/groups (4 distinct groups on live data: LOGITRAK, Camion Demo, W-Police de Bern, B Phida transport). All 7 pytest cases pass (3 new + 4 iter-9 invariants) in 10.96s. Frontend on live URL: Analyse flotte header 'Analyse d'utilisation de la flotte' + subtitle '... — 12 vehicules'; group-filter dropdown renders with 'Tous les groupes' + 4 real groups. Zone 1 shows the 6 KPI cards (kpi-used 41.7% 5/12 with kpi-inactive badge '7 immobiles (0 km)', kpi-cat-sous_utilise=2 17%, modere=0 0%, bonne=2 17%, tres_utilise=1 8%, kpi-intensity=665 km/actif volume 3323 km). Invariant verified: 4 categories (2+0+2+1) + inactive (7) = 12 = total. Each filter button count matches its KPI (sous_utilise 2, modere 0, bonne 2, tres_utilise 1, inactif 7). Zone 2: analyse-bar stacked segments present with cat-bar-* clickable; analyse-chart shows French days Sam/Dim/Lun/Mar/Mer/Jeu/Ven with per-bar X/12 + % labels and dotted mean line; clicking a bar opens day-filter-banner ('Lundi 3 aout : 3/12 vehicules (25%) — 452 km' tooltip observed). Zone 3: analyse-recos shows 5 deterministic recos (Equilibrage / Reduction / Concentration / Charge / Donnees) with NO fabricated CHF/mois, no 'transferer 30%', no 'pertes ralenti CHF'; reco-eco score line loads after ~10-15s showing 'Score eco moyen du parc : 64/100 — moyenne des notations Navixy (plugin 46) sur 5 vehicules avec donnees'. analyse-fuel shows only 3 stats (3 323 km / 282.4 L / 565 CHF) plus a plain-text disclaimer 'Aucune perte de ralenti estimee — historique ralenti non disponible' (disclaimer only, no fabricated number). Group filter interaction: selecting LOGITRAK narrows table 12→3 and recalculates KPI (kpi-used 33.3% 1/3 — 2 immobiles); selecting 'Tous' restores 12 rows. Cross-coherence: kpi-cat-bonne → 2 filtered rows == cat-bar-bonne → 2 filtered rows == bonne count 2. Row click opens vehicle drawer (Escape closes). Regression on tab-overview, tab-drivers, tab-vehicles, tab-costs: all load without console errors.

issues: The 'Modere' KPI card and its filter button (0 count) are rendered dimmed but the KPI card itself is not disabled — clicking kpi-cat-modere while count is 0 still toggles the ring/border. The filter button correctly ignores click (guarded by f.count > 0). Consider matching behavior between kpi card and filter button for consistency.

action_items: None blocking. Minor: align kpi-cat-modere click guard with analyse-filter-modere (both should no-op when count=0).
critical_code_review_comments: AnalyseFlotteTab.jsx L142: /api/groups fetch has no dependency on API base changes and swallows all errors silently (setGroups([])). If Navixy is temporarily unavailable, the group filter simply disappears without any user feedback. Consider surfacing a subtle status or retry.

AnalyseFlotteTab.jsx L146: groupOptions filters to groups that already have vehicles in the current period. This is correct but means the visible option set may change between periods; ensure the currently-selected groupFilter is reset to 'all' if it disappears from the list to avoid a stale filter showing 0 vehicles.
